content.comment_body: Hi, I'm working on automating a fertigation system where a water pump needs to operate four times daily. I managed to set up a timer to run every two hours, but I'm unsure how to make it run for just 10 minutes each time. Is there a way to synchronize this with a real time clock using [company_name] [product_name]?

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. To help you troubleshoot, it would be useful if you could share your current program. Please upload it as a ZIP file. Also, could you clarify what a 'fertigation system' is?

I see you've updated your post since my first reply. You haven't specified the exact [product_name] version or provided the [article_no]. If you have the FS4 variant, you can utilize an NTP time server.
Fertigation is a process combining watering and fertilizer delivery, managed automatically. I'm using [product_name] [version_no].
I'm currently using hours as seconds in each timer since I'm testing in simulation mode.
Check the attached file. To run a process four times daily for 10 minutes each, you can use weekly timers.
Why am I unable to download the program?
Are you unable to download the file or open it? If opening the LSC file with the LSC software isn't working, you might be using an incompatible version. Which version do you have installed?
I receive an error message when trying to download.
You must be logged into the forum to download files.
